body.message: Why is transport my biggest source?

body.reply: Transport represents 31.3% (40.0 kg CO2e) of your 128.0 kg monthly footprint, primarily due to regular petrol two-wheeler commuting. Transitioning 2 trips weekly to public bus transit saves an estimated 14.0 kg CO2e monthly.

factor_sources: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) Baseline Database v19 (2024)
ARAI / MoEFCC GHG Third National Communication (2023)

body.disclaimer: Estimates based on published emission factors, not measured emissions.
